value.rationale: The source leaves out the natural boundary between its expansion and period-doubling regimes. A small correction erased by the limiting return map creates infinitely many genuine attracting primitive-M windows, with a second exponentially small scale in relative width and a subcritical period-2M companion. Exact critical-slope bifurcation structure is therefore different from its limiting model, and the quantified regime is useful when studying grazing families at high return indices.
